g.text: Alpha Financial Analyst — Revised production HLD
INTERVIEW DESIGN · local measurements first; distributed scale is a projection. Exact evidence, durable jobs and qualified model fallbacks.
SERVING PLANE · start locally; AWS deployment is a proposal, gated on ADR-0006
Redis cache / wakeup optional; events replay
policy + verify final memo; fenced commit
RETRIEVAL TIER · bounded shard count + issuer filter; measure hot-issuer skew and query fan-out
Illustrative values; issuer filter ≠ customer authorization
50 fused candidates → qualified reranker → top 8; log latency
12 TOTAL logical shards · replication 2 → 24 shard replicas
CIK issuer payload index · benchmark m / ef and filter behavior
explicit float16 originals on disk · int8 copy / rescore if approved
dense[1024] + named sparse BM25 · pin complete index release
Issuer filters narrow candidates; shards may fan out.
Pin index_release + retrieval_config in cache identity.
Stage, validate, promote; retain rollback release.
only if measured cost / recovery justifies
Default: progress SSE, then verified / policy-approved memo.
No raw draft tokens; optional provisional mode needs its own gate.
INGESTION · local Python + immutable files first; optional organizational lakehouse shown below
OPTIONAL lakehouse: justify lag, recovery, consumers and cost.
A second reader alone does not require Kafka.
Account for raw and vector transfers + replicas + rebuilds.
AWS→Azure→AWS costs and operations require a full budget.
# Example contracts; Python locally, dbt in lakehouse
publish: expected chunks == visible chunks; no stale IDs
freshness: source-specific age, ingestion lag, outage budget
OBSERVABILITY & EVAL · label every claim IMPLEMENTED / MEASURED / PROPOSED / PROJECTED
retrieval: paired bootstrap CI + loss margin
EXPERIMENT LOG TEMPLATE — no measured values asserted
Test an affordable corpus and concurrency ladder; log the stopping point. Extrapolate with explicit assumptions and headroom.
Do not equate registered users, daily requests, concurrent jobs, documents or chunks. Production deployment remains gated.
